lines.zh: 高雄北邊的仁武，田野與街巷之間，住著一群熱心人。
lines.en: In Renwu, north Kaohsiung, among fields and lanes, live warm-hearted people.

lines.zh: 他們相信，一點一滴的善意，能讓家鄉更溫暖。
lines.en: They believe small acts of kindness can make their hometown warmer.

lines.zh: 這是高雄市堅山慈善會的故事。
lines.en: This is the story of the Kaohsiung Jianshan Charity Association.

lines.zh: 一群鄉親聚在一起，成立了堅山慈善會。
lines.en: A group of neighbours came together and founded the association.

lines.zh: 會址設在仁武區仁林路，受高雄市社會局輔導。
lines.en: Based on Renlin Road, Renwu, it works under the city's Social Affairs Bureau.

lines.zh: 歷任理事長一棒接一棒，把善的火炬傳下去。
lines.en: Chairperson after chairperson has carried the torch of kindness forward.

lines.zh: 陳國泰理事長與夫人吳惠豐女士，以身作則。
lines.en: Chairman Chen Kuo-tai and his wife, Ms. Wu Hui-feng, led by example.

lines.zh: 他們走進社區，把關懷送到需要的人身邊。
lines.en: They walked into the community, bringing care to those in need.

scenes.name: 清寒優秀學生獎助學金

lines.zh: 堅山最重要的工作之一，是清寒優秀學生獎助學金。
lines.en: One of its key works is a scholarship for bright students in need.

lines.zh: 仁武、大樹、鳥松、大社等地區的孩子都受惠。
lines.en: Children from Renwu, Dashu, Niaosong, Dashe and nearby benefit.

lines.zh: 也鼓勵高雄的大學生，學業與品德兼優。
lines.en: It also encourages Kaohsiung university students to excel in study and character.

lines.zh: 一份獎學金，讓努力的孩子能安心讀書。
lines.en: One scholarship lets a hard-working child study without worry.

lines.zh: 每年，堅山至少舉辦一次捐血活動。
lines.en: Every year, Jianshan holds at least one blood drive.

lines.zh: 二〇二四年五月，觀音山入口停了兩台捐血車。
lines.en: In May 2024, two blood buses parked at the Guanyin Mountain entrance.

lines.zh: 志工備好冰涼茶水，熱情引導捐血民眾。
lines.en: Volunteers served cool tea and warmly guided the donors.

lines.zh: 一天下來，募得三百七十二袋熱血。
lines.en: By day's end, 372 bags of precious blood had been collected.

lines.zh: 李國忠理事長說，這是會友凝聚力與愛心的成果。
lines.en: Chairman Li Kuo-chung called it the fruit of members' unity and love.

lines.zh: 堅山也是登記在案的志工團隊，服務不分晴雨。
lines.en: Jianshan is also a registered volunteer team, serving rain or shine.

lines.zh: 風雨中，志工撐起傘，把關懷送進巷弄。
lines.en: Through wind and rain, volunteers carry care into the alleys.

lines.zh: 二〇二五年，獎助學金公文再次寄往各校。
lines.en: In 2025, scholarship notices were once again sent to schools.

lines.zh: 讓更多孩子知道，有人在背後支持著他們。
lines.en: So more children know that someone is standing behind them.

lines.zh: 也許有一天，受助的孩子，也會成為助人的人。
lines.en: Perhaps one day, the children who were helped will help others.

lines.zh: 善的循環，就從仁武這片土地，慢慢擴散。
lines.en: A circle of kindness, spreading slowly from the land of Renwu.

lines.zh: 高雄市堅山慈善會，邀您一起，讓愛延續。
lines.en: The Jianshan Charity Association invites you to keep love going.
